purpose: Teach: 頒布/加味/横行/内職/創始/既得/代用/一掃

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の頒布範囲を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren, verify the distribution scope of that paper.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Sits back slightly in chair. Not unkind, but the tone of someone who expects the work to be done well. Brief eye contact, then back to his own work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文に最新研究を加味しております
lines.en: Yes, sir. I've incorporated the latest research into the paper.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly eager to show readiness. Sits up a little straighter. Voice steady but with an undertone of wanting to be taken seriously. No hedging.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究界で不正データが横行している
lines.en: Ren, there's fraudulent data circulating throughout the research world right now.
lines.style: Deliberate pace. The words land with quiet weight. Not lecturing—informing him of a problem he needs to internalize. A slight lean forward, eyes steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学費補填のため内職をしている学生もおります
lines.en: Yes, I understand. Some students even work side jobs to supplement their tuition.
lines.style: Soft acknowledgment. Shows he's understood the deeper point—the pressure that makes shortcuts tempting. Slight nod. Respectful, but with a thread of quiet concern underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、創始者の論文を読み返せ
lines.en: Ren, go back and reread the founder's papers.
lines.style: Firm instruction, but not harsh. The tone of someone who trusts him to understand why this matters. Deliberate pause after his name, then the direction given with clarity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。既得の特許で安住せず研究を進めます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I won't rest on established patents. I'll keep pushing the research forward.
lines.style: Resolute undertone. Not defensive, but grounded—he's heard the lesson and is committing to it. Voice strengthens slightly on 'forward.' The kind of response that says he gets it now.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、希少試薬の代用案を考えろ
lines.en: Ren, come up with alternative approaches for the rare reagents.
lines.style: Expectant, matter-of-fact. The tone assumes he's capable of this. Not a question, but not dismissive either. Professional distance that carries respect underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。古い実験データを一掃して整理します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll go through the old experimental data, clear it out, and reorganize everything from scratch.
lines.style: Steady commitment. A slight closing quality—he's understood, he's ready, and he's moving forward. Voice settles with quiet resolve. The 'yes' carries finality, not hesitation.
